Warehouse.description: Represents a storage facility at airbases that manages aircraft, munitions, and fuel resources available to coalition forces.

getByName.description: Returns a `Warehouse` object with the specified name, or `nil` if not found.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the warehouse.

getCargoAsWarehouse.description: Returns a `Warehouse` object associated with a cargo static object, or `nil` if not applicable.

params.name: cargo
params.description: The cargo static object.

getResourceMap.description: Returns a table of all warehouses in the mission, indexed by warehouse name.

addItem.description: Adds the specified quantity of an item to the warehouse inventory.

getItemCount.description: Returns a `number` representing the quantity of the specified item in the warehouse.

setItem.description: Sets the exact quantity of an item in the warehouse inventory, replacing any existing amount.

removeItem.description: Removes the specified quantity of an item from the warehouse inventory.

addLiquid.description: Adds the specified amount of liquid fuel to the warehouse inventory.

getLiquidAmount.description: Returns a `number` representing the quantity of the specified liquid fuel in the warehouse.

setLiquidAmount.description: Sets the exact amount of a liquid fuel in the warehouse inventory, replacing any existing amount.

removeLiquid.description: Removes the specified amount of liquid fuel from the warehouse inventory.

getOwner.description: Returns the `Airbase` object that owns this warehouse.

getInventory.description: Returns a table containing a complete inventory of all items in the warehouse.

env.description: Provides functions for logging and accessing mission environment data in the DCS World scripting environment. All logging messages are written to the dcs.log file in the user's Saved Games folder.

info.description: Writes an informational message to the DCS log file, with an optional in-game notification popup.

params.name: message
params.description: Text content to write to the log file.

params.name: showMessageBox
params.description: `true` to display an in-game popup with the message, `false` to log silently.

warning.description: Writes a warning message to the DCS log file, with an optional in-game notification popup.

params.name: message
params.description: Text content to write to the log file.

params.name: showMessageBox
params.description: `true` to display an in-game popup with the message, `false` to log silently.

error.description: Writes an error message to the DCS log file, with an optional in-game notification popup.

params.name: message
params.description: Text content to write to the log file.

params.name: showMessageBox
params.description: `true` to display an in-game popup with the message, `false` to log silently.

setErrorMessageBoxEnabled.description: Configures whether Lua runtime errors generate in-game popup notifications.

params.name: enabled
params.description: `true` to display error message boxes for Lua errors, `false` to suppress them.

getValueDictByKey.description: Retrieves a value from the mission dictionary using the specified key.

params.name: key
params.description: Dictionary key to look up in the mission environment.

showTraining.description: Shows the training interface. Note: Undocumented function in the DCS API.

mission.description: Table containing the complete mission data structure as defined in the mission file.

warehouses.description: Table containing the complete warehouse inventory data structure for the current mission.

world.description: Provides functions for managing events, accessing game world information, and controlling weather conditions in the DCS World.

addEventHandler.description: Registers an event handler table to be called when simulator events occur. The table must contain an onEvent method.

params.name: handler
params.description: A table containing an onEvent method that will be called with event data when events occur.

removeEventHandler.description: Unregisters a previously added event handler table.

params.name: handler
params.description: The event handler table to remove. Must be the same table that was passed to addEventHandler.

onEvent.description: Handles simulator events internally for the DCS Mission environment. Different event types produce different event data structures.

params.name: eventData
params.description: Event data containing information about the triggered event. The specific event type determines which fields are available.

getPlayer.description: Returns the `Unit` controlled by the player, or `nil` if no unit is directly controlled.

getAirbases.description: Returns a numerically indexed table of all airbase objects in the mission.

searchObjects.description: Returns objects within a specified 3D volume, optionally applying a handler function to each found object.

params.name: category
params.description: The category or categories of objects to search for.

params.name: searchVolume
params.description: A table defining the search volume.

params.name: Handler
params.description: An optional handler function to run on each found object.

params.name: data
params.description: Optional data to pass to the handler function.

getMarkPanels.description: Returns a table of all active map markers and drawn shapes in the mission.

removeJunk.description: Removes debris within a specified volume, returning the number of items cleared.

params.name: searchVolume
params.description: A table defining the volume from which to remove junk.

getPersistenceData.description: Returns mission persistence data used for saving mission state.

runPersistenceHandlers.description: Executes all registered persistence handler functions.

setPersistenceHandler.description: Registers a handler function for mission persistence operations.

params.name: handler
params.description: The persistence handler function.

weather.description: Provides functions for controlling fog and weather conditions in the mission.

getFogThickness.description: Returns a `number` representing the current fog thickness in meters.

setFogThickness.description: Sets the fog thickness at sea level in meters, canceling any active fog animation.

params.name: thickness
params.description: Fog thickness in meters (0 or 100-5000).

getFogVisibilityDistance.description: Returns a `number` representing the current fog visibility distance in meters.

setFogVisibilityDistance.description: Sets the maximum visibility at sea level in meters, canceling any active fog animation.

params.name: visibility
params.description: Visibility distance in meters (0 or 100-100000).

setFogAnimation.description: Configures fog to change dynamically over time based on provided keyframes.

params.name: fogAnimationKeys
params.description: Table of animation keys or nil to discard animation.

event.description: Enumerator for event types that can occur in the DCS World simulation.

BirthPlace.description: Enumerator for spawn locations of aircraft and helicopters.

VolumeType.description: Enumerator for 3D volume types used in spatial queries.

eventHandlers.description: Table of all registered event handler functions.

persistenceHandlers.description: Table of all registered persistence handler functions.

Group.description: Represents a collection of related units that operate together as a tactical entity in the DCS World environment.

getByName.description: Returns a `Group` object with the specified name, or `nil` if no such group exists. Works with both active and inactive groups.

params.name: name
params.description: Unique identifier of the group to retrieve.

isExist.description: Returns `true` if this group currently exists in the mission environment.

activate.description: Activates this group if it has delayed start or late activation settings, making it appear in the mission.

destroy.description: Removes this group and all its units from the game world without triggering events, causing them to completely disappear.

getCategory.description: Returns an enumerator value indicating both the generic object category and specific group type for this group.

getCategoryEx.description: Returns a `Group.Category` enumerator value indicating the specific type of this group (e.g., AIRPLANE, HELICOPTER, GROUND).

getCoalition.description: Returns a `coalition.side` enumerator value indicating which faction this group belongs to.

getName.description: Returns a `string` representing the unique name identifier of this group.

getID.description: Returns a `number` representing the unique mission ID of this group.

getUnit.description: Returns a `Unit` object at the specified index within this group, or `nil` if no unit exists at that index.

params.name: UnitIndex
params.description: Numeric index of the unit to retrieve, starting from 1.

getUnits.description: Returns a numerically indexed table of `Unit` objects belonging to this group, ordered by their position in the group.

getSize.description: Returns a `number` representing the current count of units in this group, which decreases as units are destroyed.

getInitialSize.description: Returns a `number` representing the original count of units in this group as defined at creation, which remains constant regardless of unit losses.

getController.description: Returns a `Controller` object that can be used to manage AI behavior for this group. Note: Ship and ground groups can only be controlled at group level.

enableEmission.description: Sets the radar emission status for all applicable units in this group, allowing control of detection signatures without changing AI behavior.

params.name: setting
params.description: `true` to enable radar emissions, `false` to disable them.

embarking.description: Returns `true` if any unit in this group is currently in the process of loading cargo.

markGroup.description: Creates a map marker visible to this group at the specified position with optional text label.

params.name: point
params.description: Position in the DCS World coordinate system where the marker will appear.

params.name: text
params.description: Optional text to display with the marker.

Controller.description: Represents an AI behavior controller that manages tasking, commands, and detection capabilities for units and groups in the DCS World environment.

setTask.description: Assigns a task to this controller's associated units or groups, replacing any current task in the queue.

params.name: task
params.description: Table defining either a main task or enroute task to assign

resetTask.description: Clears all tasks from this controller's task queue, causing controlled units to cease their current activity.

pushTask.description: Adds a task to the front of this controller's task queue, making it the highest priority task to execute.

params.name: task
params.description: Table defining either a main task or enroute task to prioritize

popTask.description: Removes the highest priority task from this controller's task queue.

hasTask.description: Returns `true` if this controller currently has at least one task in its queue.

setCommand.description: Issues an immediate command to this controller that executes instantly and does not affect the current task queue.

params.name: command
params.description: Table defining the command to execute

setOption.description: Configures a behavior option for this controller that affects how it performs all tasks and commands.

params.name: optionId
params.description: Option identifier from AI.Option namespaces (Air, Ground, or Naval)

params.name: optionValue
params.description: Value to set for the specified option

setOnOff.description: Enables or disables the AI behavior for this controller's ground or naval units. Note: Does not work with aircraft or helicopters.

params.name: value
params.description: `true` to enable AI behavior, `false` to disable

setAltitude.description: Sets the altitude for this controller's aircraft group, with options to maintain across waypoints and specify altitude type.

params.name: altitude
params.description: Target altitude in meters

params.name: keep
params.description: `true` to maintain altitude across waypoints, `false` to return to route-defined altitudes

params.name: altType
params.description: Altitude reference type: "BARO" (barometric) or "RADIO" (radar)

setSpeed.description: Sets the movement speed for this controller's group, with option to maintain across waypoints.

params.name: speed
params.description: Target speed in meters per second

params.name: keep
params.description: `true` to maintain speed across waypoints, `false` to return to route-defined speeds

knowTarget.description: Forces a unit-level controller to have awareness of a specific target without natural detection. Note: Does not work at group level.

params.name: object
params.description: Target object to become aware of

params.name: type
params.description: `true` to know the target type, `false` otherwise

params.name: distance
params.description: `true` to know the target distance, `false` otherwise

isTargetDetected.description: Returns multiple values indicating whether and how the specified target is detected by this controller's unit or group.

params.name: Target
params.description: Target object to check detection status

params.name: detectionType1
params.description: First detection method to check

params.name: detectionType2
params.description: Second detection method to check

params.name: detectionType3
params.description: Third detection method to check

getDetectedTargets.description: Returns a numerically indexed table of tables containing detection information about targets detected by this controller, optionally filtered by detection methods.

params.name: detectionType1
params.description: First detection method to filter by

params.name: detectionType2
params.description: Second detection method to filter by

params.name: detectionType3
params.description: Third detection method to filter by

Spot.description: Represents a targeting designation beam (laser or infrared) used for marking targets in the DCS World environment.

destroy.description: Removes this spot from the mission, immediately terminating the targeting beam.

getCategory.description: Returns two category enumerator values identifying this spot's primary and secondary classifications.

getCategoryEx.description: Returns a `Spot.Category` enumerator value indicating whether this spot is infrared or laser.

getPoint.description: Returns a `Vec3` representing the target point of this beam in the DCS World coordinate system.

setPoint.description: Changes the target endpoint of this beam to a new position in the DCS World coordinate system.

params.name: point
params.description: New target position in the DCS World coordinate system.

getCode.description: Returns the 4-digit laser code number used for target designation with this beam.

setCode.description: Sets a new 4-digit laser code (1111-1788) for this beam, determining which guided weapons can track it.

params.name: code
params.description: New laser code value between 1111 and 1788.

createInfraRed.description: Creates an infrared targeting beam from a source object to a specified point, visible only through night vision devices.

params.name: source
params.description: Source object that will emit the infrared beam.

params.name: localRef
params.description: Optional local reference point on the source object. If `nil`, uses the object's center.

params.name: point
params.description: Target point for the infrared beam in the DCS World coordinate system.

createLaser.description: Creates a laser targeting beam from a source object to a specified point in the DCS World coordinate system.

params.name: source
params.description: Source object that will emit the laser beam.

params.name: localRef
params.description: Optional local reference point on the source object. If `nil`, uses the object's center.

params.name: point
params.description: Target point for the laser beam in the DCS World coordinate system.

params.name: laserCode
params.description: Optional 4-digit laser code between 1111 and 1788. If omitted, creates an infrared beam.

Airbase.description: Represents airport and carrier facilities in the DCS World environment.

getByName.description: Returns an `Airbase` object corresponding to the airbase with the specified name, or `nil` if no such airbase exists.

getCommunicator.description: Returns a communicator object for the specified airbase.

getCountry.description: Returns a country ID for the specified airbase.

getDescByName.description: Returns a table containing detailed information about the airbase with the specified name.

getForcesName.description: Returns a string representing the forces name for the airbase.

getLife.description: Returns the current life/health value of the specified airbase.

getNearest.description: Returns the nearest airbase object to the specified point.

getWorldID.description: Returns the world ID of the specified airbase.

getCallsign.description: Returns a `string` representing the localized callsign of this airbase.

getUnit.description: Returns a `Unit` object, a `StaticObject`, or `nil` if no object exists at the specified index.

getID.description: Returns a `number` representing the unique mission ID of this airbase.

getCategory.description: Returns an `Object.Category` enumerator value indicating the general category of this object.

getCategoryEx.description: Returns an `Airbase.Category` enumerator value indicating the specific type of this airbase.

getParking.description: Returns a numerically indexed table where each element is a table detailing an airbase parking spot, optionally filtered by availability.

getRunways.description: Returns a numerically indexed table where each element is a table detailing runway information, including dimensions, course, and name.

getDispatcherTowerPos.description: Returns a `Vec3` representing the position of the airbase's dispatcher tower in the DCS World coordinate system, or `nil` if not available.

getRadioSilentMode.description: Returns a `boolean` indicating whether the ATC for this airbase is in silent mode.

setRadioSilentMode.description: Sets the silent mode status for the airbase's ATC, determining if it responds to radio communications from aircraft.

autoCapture.description: Enables or disables the auto-capture mechanic for this airbase, affecting how control can change between coalitions.

autoCaptureIsOn.description: Returns a `boolean` indicating whether the auto-capture feature is enabled for this airbase.

setCoalition.description: Changes this airbase's coalition to the specified side, affecting which faction controls it.

getWarehouse.description: Returns a `Warehouse` object associated with this airbase, used to manage its inventory.

getName.description: Returns a `string` representing the name of this airbase.

getTypeName.description: Returns a `string` representing the type name of this airbase.

getPoint.description: Returns a `Vec3` representing the position of this airbase in the DCS World coordinate system.

getPosition.description: Returns a `Position3` representing the precise position and orientation of this airbase in the DCS World coordinate system.

getVelocity.description: Returns a `Vec3` representing the velocity of this airbase in the DCS World coordinate system.

getDesc.description: Returns a table containing a detailed description of this airbase, including its ID, callsign, category, and operational data.

getCoalition.description: Returns a `coalition.side` enumerator value indicating which coalition controls this airbase.

land.description: Provides functions for querying terrain geometry in the mission environment.

getHeight.description: Returns terrain height (distance from sea level) at the specified point.

params.name: point
params.description: Position coordinates to check.

getSurfaceHeightWithSeabed.description: Returns both terrain height and seabed depth at the specified point as `{number, number}` where the first value is height above sea level and the second is seabed depth.

params.name: point
params.description: Position coordinates to check.

getSurfaceType.description: Returns the surface type enum at the specified point.

params.name: point
params.description: Position coordinates to check.

isVisible.description:
Performs line-of-sight check between two points, returning whether terrain obstructs visibility.

Note: This only tests terrain collision - buildings and other objects are not considered.
When working with ground objects, offset the Y-value (height) to prevent false negatives from the origin point clipping into terrain.

params.name: origin
params.description: Starting point of the line-of-sight check.

params.name: destination
params.description: Ending point of the line-of-sight check.

getIP.description: Returns the intersection point where a ray originating from `origin` in the given direction intersects terrain, or `nil` if no intersection within specified distance.

params.name: origin
params.description: Starting point of the ray.

params.name: direction
params.description: Normalized direction vector of the ray.

params.name: distance
params.description: Maximum distance to check for intersection.

profile.description: Returns a table of `Vec3` points representing the terrain profile between two points.

params.name: origin
params.description: Starting point of the profile.

params.name: destination
params.description: Ending point of the profile.

getClosestPointOnRoads.description:
Returns X and Y coordinates of the nearest point on a road from the given position.

Note: This function accepts individual X/Y coordinates rather than `Vec2` or `Vec3` objects.

params.name: roadType
params.description: Road type to search. Valid values: `'roads'`, `'railroads'`.

params.name: xCoord
params.description: X-coordinate (map X) of reference point.

params.name: yCoord
params.description: Y-coordinate (map Z) of reference point.

findPathOnRoads.description:
Returns a route as a sequence of points along roads between start and destination.

The result is a numerically-indexed table of `Vec2` points from start to destination.

Note: When using railroad paths, the parameter value should be `'rails'` (not `'railroads'`).

params.name: roadType
params.description: Road type to use. Valid values: `'roads'`, `'rails'`.

params.name: xCoord
params.description: X-coordinate (map X) of starting point.

params.name: yCoord
params.description: Y-coordinate (map Z) of starting point.

params.name: destX
params.description: X-coordinate (map X) of destination point.

params.name: destY
params.description: Y-coordinate (map Z) of destination point.

coalition.description: Provides functions for managing faction-based entities in the DCS World environment, including unit information retrieval, group spawning, and static object creation.

addGroup.description: Adds a new group to the mission for the specified coalition and country, returning a `function` that can be called to complete the spawn process.

params.name: coalition
params.description: Coalition side enumeration value.

params.name: country
params.description: Country identifier within the coalition.

params.name: groupData
params.description: Table defining the group configuration to be spawned.

add_dyn_group.description: Adds a dynamic (runtime-created) group to the mission for the specified coalition and country, returning a `function` that finalizes the spawn process.

params.name: coalition
params.description: Coalition side enumeration value.

params.name: country
params.description: Country identifier within the coalition.

params.name: groupData
params.description: Table defining the dynamic group configuration to be spawned.

remove_dyn_group.description: Removes a previously added dynamic group from the mission, returning `true` if successful.

params.name: groupName
params.description: Name of the dynamic group to remove from the mission.

addStaticObject.description: Adds a new static object to the mission for the specified country, returning a `StaticObject`. The coalition is automatically determined from the country identifier.

params.name: country
params.description: Country identifier that determines which coalition the static object will belong to.

params.name: staticData
params.description: Table defining the static object configuration to be spawned.

getGroups.description: Returns a numerically indexed table of `Group` objects belonging to the specified coalition and country.

params.name: coalition
params.description: Coalition side enumeration value.

params.name: country
params.description: Country identifier within the coalition.

getStaticObjects.description: Returns a numerically indexed table of `StaticObject` objects belonging to the specified coalition and country.

params.name: coalition
params.description: Coalition side enumeration value.

params.name: country
params.description: Country identifier within the coalition.

getAirbases.description: Returns a numerically indexed table of `Airbase` objects belonging to the specified coalition and country.

params.name: coalition
params.description: Coalition side enumeration value.

params.name: country
params.description: Country identifier within the coalition.

getPlayers.description: Returns a numerically indexed table of `Unit` objects representing player-controlled units in the specified coalition.

params.name: coalition
params.description: Coalition side enumeration value.

getServiceProviders.description: Returns a numerically indexed table of `Unit` objects providing the specified service type within the coalition.

params.name: coalition
params.description: Coalition side enumeration value.

params.name: service
params.description: Service type enumeration value (e.g., ATC, AWACS, TANKER, FAC).

addRefPoint.description: Adds a reference point for the specified coalition, returning a `function` that finalizes the addition.

params.name: coalition
params.description: Coalition side enumeration value.

params.name: refPoint
params.description: Table defining the reference point to be added.

getRefPoints.description: Returns a table of reference points defined for the specified coalition.

params.name: coalition
params.description: Coalition side enumeration value.

getMainRefPoint.description: Returns a table representing the primary reference point for the specified coalition.

params.name: coalition
params.description: Coalition side enumeration value.

getCountryCoalition.description: Returns a `number` representing the coalition identifier that the specified country belongs to.

params.name: country
params.description: Country identifier to query.

checkChooseCargo.description: Returns `true` if cargo selection is possible for the specified unit within the coalition.

params.name: coalition
params.description: Coalition side enumeration value.

params.name: unitId
params.description: Unique identifier of the unit to check.

checkDescent.description: Returns `true` if a descent operation (e.g., paratrooper drop) is possible for the specified unit.

params.name: coalition
params.description: Coalition side enumeration value.

params.name: unitId
params.description: Unique identifier of the unit to check.

getAllDescents.description: Returns a table of all available descent operations (e.g., paratroopers, cargo) for the specified coalition.

params.name: coalition
params.description: Coalition side enumeration value.

getDescentsOnBoard.description: Returns a table of all descent operations (e.g., paratroopers, cargo) currently loaded on the specified unit.

params.name: unitId
params.description: Unique identifier of the unit to query.

side.description: Provides access to the coalition side enumerator for faction identification.

service.description: Provides access to the service type enumerator for communications services.

missionCommands.description: Provides functions for creating and managing interactive menu commands in the F10 radio menu.

addCommand.description: Adds an interactive command to the F10 radio menu for all players that executes a specified Lua function when selected.

params.name: name
params.description: Display text for the menu command.

params.name: path
params.description: Path to parent menu as a sequence table of menu names. If `nil`, command is added to root menu.

params.name: functionToRun
params.description: Function to execute when command is selected.

params.name: anyArguement
params.description: Optional value passed to `functionToRun` when executed.

addSubMenu.description: Creates a submenu in the F10 radio menu for all players, which can contain additional commands or nested submenus.

params.name: name
params.description: Display text for the submenu.

params.name: path
params.description: Path to parent menu as a sequence table of menu names. If `nil`, submenu is added to root menu.

removeItem.description: Removes a menu item or entire submenu from the F10 radio menu for all players.

params.name: path
params.description: Path to the menu item as a sequence table of menu names. If `nil`, removes all items.

addCommandForCoalition.description: Adds an interactive command to the F10 radio menu for players of a specific coalition.

params.name: coalition.side

params.description: Display text for the menu command.

params.name: path
params.description: Path to parent menu as a sequence table of menu names. If `nil`, command is added to root menu.

params.name: functionToRun
params.description: Function to execute when command is selected.

params.name: anyArguement
params.description: Optional value passed to `functionToRun` when executed.

addSubMenuForCoalition.description: Creates a submenu in the F10 radio menu for players of a specific coalition.

params.name: coalitionSide
params.description: Target coalition as a `coalition.side` enum value.

params.name: name
params.description: Display text for the submenu.

params.name: path
params.description: Path to parent menu as a sequence table of menu names. If `nil`, submenu is added to root menu.

removeItemForCoalition.description: Removes a menu item or entire submenu from the F10 radio menu for a specific coalition.

params.name: coalitionSide
params.description: Target coalition as a `coalition.side` enum value.

params.name: path
params.description: Path to the menu item as a sequence table of menu names. If `nil`, removes all items for the coalition.

addCommandForGroup.description: Adds an interactive command to the F10 radio menu for players in a specific group.

params.name: groupId
params.description: ID of the target group.

params.name: name
params.description: Display text for the menu command.

params.name: path

scheduleFunction.description: Schedules a function to execute at a specific mission time, with optional repetition if the function returns a future time value.

params.name: functionToCall
params.description: Function to be executed at the scheduled time.

params.name: anyFunctionArguement
params.description: Parameters to pass to the scheduled function.

params.name: modelTime
params.description: Mission time in seconds when the function should execute.

examples.description: The following will run a function named "main" 120 seconds from one the code would run.
The following example sets up a repetitive call loop where function CheckStatus is called every 5 seconds or.
examples.code:
function CheckStatus(ourArgument, time)
 -- Do things to check, use ourArgument (which is the scheduleFunction's second argument)
 if ourArgument == 53 and someExternalCondition then
   -- Keep going
   return time + 5
 else
   -- That's it we're done looping
   return nil
 end
end
timer.scheduleFunction(CheckStatus, 53, timer.getTime() + 5)

examples.description: This function will check if any red coalition units are in a trigger zone named "anyReds" and will set the flag "zoneOccupied" to true. This function will schedule itself to run every 60 seconds.
examples.code:
local function checkZone(zoneName)
   timer.scheduleFunction(checkZone, zoneName, timer.getTime() + 60)
   local zone = trigger.misc.getZone(zoneName)
   local groups = coalition.getGroups(1)
   local count = 0 
   for i = 1, #groups do
      local units = groups[i]:getUnits()
      for j = 1, #units do
          local unitPos = units[j]:getpoint()
           if math.sqrt((zone.point.x - unitPos.x)^2 + (zone.point.z - unitPos.z)^2) < zone.radius then
               count = count + 1
           end
      end
   end
   if count > 0 then
       trigger.action.setUserFlag("zoneOccupied", true)
   else 
      trigger.action.setUserFlag("zoneOccupied", false)
   end
 end
 checkZone("anyReds")

removeFunction.description: Cancels a previously scheduled function, preventing it from executing.

params.name: functionId
params.description: Identifier returned by `scheduleFunction()` for the function to cancel.

examples.description: The following will run a function named "main" 120 seconds from one the code would run.
If further down in the code it was decided to stop main() from running it may look like this.
examples.code:
if abort == true then  
  timer.removeFunction(id)
end

setFunctionTime.description: Modifies the execution time of a previously scheduled function.

params.name: functionId
params.description: Identifier returned by `scheduleFunction()` for the function to reschedule.

params.name: modelTime
params.description: New mission time in seconds when the function should execute.

examples.description: The following will run a function named "main" 120 seconds from one the code would run.
If further down in the code it was decided to run the main() function sooner it could look like this
examples.code:
if mustGoFaster == true then  
  timer.setFunctionTime(id, timer.getTime() + 1)
end

life.description: A numeric value representing the initial health or integrity level of the static object.

box.description: A box (two Vec3 points) representing the three-dimensional collision boundaries of the static object in the DCS World coordinate system.

StaticObjectSpawnData.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing spawn parameters for a static object used with coalition.addStaticObject.

name.description: A string identifier for the static object.

type.description: A string specifying the classification or model type of the static object.

x.description: X coordinate of the static object's position in the DCS World coordinate system.

y.description: Y coordinate of the static object's position in the DCS World coordinate system.

heading.description: Orientation angle in radians representing the static object's heading in the DCS World.

category.description: A string specifying the functional category of the static object.

dead.description: Controls whether the static object spawns in a destroyed state.

shape_name.description: A string identifying the 3D model resource used to render the static object.

rate.description: A numeric value controlling the visual appearance rate, typically set to 100.

canCargo.description: Controls whether the static object can be loaded as cargo.

mass.description: A numeric value specifying the object's mass in kilograms.

country.id.description: Enumerator for country identifiers, used to specify nation affiliation for units and coalition forces in the DCS World.

country.name.description: Enumerator for retrieving country names from numeric identifiers, providing a reverse lookup of country.id values.

GroupSpawnData.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing a group to be spawned with coalition.addGroup or coalition.add_dyn_group functions.

name.description: A string identifier for the group, must be unique within the mission.

task.description: The primary mission task assigned to the group, determines default behavior patterns.

units.description: A numerically indexed table of unit definitions for all units in the group, each containing position, type, and other properties.

x.description: X coordinate of the group's reference position in the DCS World coordinate system.

y.description: Y coordinate of the group's reference position in the DCS World coordinate system.

start_time.description: Time in seconds after mission start when the group will spawn (0 for immediate spawn).

visible.description: Controls visibility of the group before its scheduled start time in the mission editor.

taskSelected.description: Indicates if the task is selected for execution when the group spawns.

route.description: A table defining waypoints and assigned tasks for the group's route, determining movement patterns.

hidden.description: Controls visibility of the group on the F10 map view for players.

groupId.description: Optional unique numeric identifier for the group, used for scripting references.

AirbaseArray.description: Represents a numerically indexed Lua table (sequence) of `Airbase` objects in the DCS World mission.

BeaconType.description: Enumerator for types of beacons that can be activated.

BeaconSystemName.description: Enumerator for types of beacon systems.

Vec3.description: Represents a 3D vector or point, typically used for positions or velocities in the DCS World coordinate system. It is a Lua table with `x`, `y`, and `z` keys.

x.description: X coordinate, which represents the north-south direction in the DCS World coordinate system. North is positive, South is negative.

y.description: Y coordinate, which represents the elevation direction in the DCS World coordinate system. Up is positive, Down is negative.

z.description: Z coordinate, which represents the east-west direction in the DCS World coordinate system. East is positive, West is negative.

Vec3Array.description: Represents a numerically indexed Lua table (sequence) of `Vec3` points in the DCS World coordinate system.

Zone.description: Trigger zone used in mission editor and referenced in zone-related events.

name.description: Name of the zone as defined in the mission editor.

radius.description: Radius of the zone in meters.

coalition.description: The `coalition.side` value indicating which faction owns or controls the zone, or `nil` if not coalition-specific.

Weapon.Category.description: Enumerator for weapon class classifications, used to categorize different types of munitions by their fundamental operational characteristics.

Weapon.GuidanceType.description: Enumerator for weapon guidance technologies, used to specify the targeting and course correction mechanisms of guided munitions.

Weapon.MissileCategory.description: Enumerator for missile operational roles, used to classify missiles by their intended target types and operational domains.

Weapon.WarheadType.description: Enumerator for warhead mechanisms, used to specify the damage-producing method employed by a weapon's terminal effect component.

Weapon.flag.description: Enumerator for weapon capability flags, used to identify specific weapon properties and subtypes through bit field values.

WeaponWarheadDetails.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing the destructive component specifications of a weapon's payload.

type.description: A `Weapon.WarheadType` enumerator specifying the primary damage mechanism of the warhead.

mass.description: A numeric value representing the total mass of the warhead in kilograms.

caliber.description: A numeric value representing the diameter of the warhead in millimeters.

explosiveMass.description: A numeric value representing the mass of high explosive material in kilograms, relevant for HE and AP+HE warheads.

shapedExplosiveMass.description: A numeric value representing the mass of shaped charge explosive material in kilograms, relevant for shaped explosive warheads.

shapedExplosiveArmorThickness.description: A numeric value representing the maximum armor penetration capability in millimeters of rolled homogeneous armor equivalent.

WeaponDesc.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing the basic properties common to all weapon types in the DCS World.

life.description: A numeric value representing the weapon's total health or structural integrity.

box.description: A box (two Vec3 points) representing the physical dimensions of the weapon in the DCS World coordinate system.

category.description: A `Weapon.Category` enumerator specifying the fundamental classification of the weapon.

warhead.description: A table representing the specifications of the weapon's destructive payload component.

WeaponDescMissile.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing the properties and capabilities of missile weapons in the DCS World.

life.description: A numeric value representing the missile's total health or structural integrity.

box.description: A box (two Vec3 points) representing the physical dimensions of the missile in the DCS World coordinate system.

category.description: A `Weapon.Category` enumerator specifying the fundamental classification of the missile.

warhead.description: A table representing the specifications of the missile's destructive payload component.

guidance.description: A `Weapon.GuidanceType` enumerator specifying the missile's targeting and course correction technology.

rangeMin.description: A numeric value representing the minimum effective engagement range in meters.

rangeMaxAltMin.description: A numeric value representing the maximum engagement range in meters when fired at minimum altitude.

rangeMaxAltMax.description: A numeric value representing the maximum engagement range in meters when fired at maximum altitude.

altMin.description: A numeric value representing the minimum effective engagement altitude in meters.

altMax.description: A numeric value representing the maximum effective engagement altitude in meters.

Nmax.description: A numeric value representing the maximum G-force the missile can sustain during flight.

fuseDist.description: A numeric value representing the distance in meters at which the missile's proximity fuse activates.

WeaponDescRocket.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing the properties and capabilities of unguided rocket weapons in the DCS World.

life.description: A numeric value representing the rocket's total health or structural integrity.

box.description: A box (two Vec3 points) representing the physical dimensions of the rocket in the DCS World coordinate system.

category.description: A `Weapon.Category` enumerator specifying the fundamental classification of the rocket.

warhead.description: A table representing the specifications of the rocket's destructive payload component.

distMin.description: A numeric value representing the minimum effective firing distance in meters.

distMax.description: A numeric value representing the maximum effective firing distance in meters.

WeaponDescBomb.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing the properties and capabilities of air-dropped bomb weapons in the DCS World.

life.description: A numeric value representing the bomb's total health or structural integrity.

box.description: A box (two Vec3 points) representing the physical dimensions of the bomb in the DCS World coordinate system.

category.description: A `Weapon.Category` enumerator specifying the fundamental classification of the bomb.

warhead.description: A table representing the specifications of the bomb's destructive payload component.

guidance.description: A `Weapon.GuidanceType` enumerator specifying the bomb's targeting and course correction technology, if applicable.

altMin.description: A numeric value representing the minimum effective release altitude in meters.

altMax.description: A numeric value representing the maximum effective release altitude in meters.

VoiceChat.Side.description: Enumerator for coalition sides, used to define which players have access to specific voice chat rooms.

VoiceChat.RoomType.description: Enumerator for voice chat room categories, used to specify the behavior and persistence of communication channels. Note: Only PERSISTENT (0) is reliable for scripted room creation.

VoiceChat.RadioHandlers.description: Enumerator for radio control properties, used to access and modify aircraft radio communication settings through the VoiceChat API.

VoiceChat.RadioHandlersSingletons.description: Enumerator for intercom system properties, used to access and modify aircraft internal communication settings through the VoiceChat API.

unknown.description: Represents a value whose type is not strictly defined or may vary across different contexts in the DCS World scripting environment.

MGRS.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing a Military Grid Reference System (MGRS) coordinate used for precise position referencing in the DCS World.

UTMZone.description: The Universal Transverse Mercator (UTM) zone designation indicating the longitude zone.

MGRSDigraph.description: The MGRS grid square designator consisting of two letters identifying a specific 100km square.

Easting.description: Easting coordinate in meters, measuring the distance eastward from the zone's central meridian.

Northing.description: Northing coordinate in meters, measuring the distance northward from the equator.

Vec2.description: Represents a 2D vector or point, typically used for map coordinates in the DCS World coordinate system. It is a Lua table with `x` and `y` keys.

x.description: X coordinate, which represents the north-south direction in the DCS World coordinate system. North is positive, South is negative.

y.description: Y coordinate, which represents the east-west direction in the DCS World coordinate system. East is positive, West is negative.

Vec2Array.description: Represents a numerically indexed Lua table (sequence) of `Vec2` points in the DCS World coordinate system.

LatLon.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing geographical coordinates using latitude and longitude values.

lat.description: Latitude value in decimal degrees, with positive values representing north of the equator and negative values representing south.

lon.description: Longitude value in decimal degrees, with positive values representing east of the prime meridian and negative values representing west.

Position3.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing both position and orientation in the DCS World coordinate system.

p.description: A `Vec3` representing the object's position in the DCS World coordinate system.

x.description: A normalized `Vec3` representing the object's forward direction vector in the DCS World coordinate system.

y.description: A normalized `Vec3` representing the object's upward direction vector in the DCS World coordinate system.

z.description: A normalized `Vec3` representing the object's rightward direction vector in the DCS World coordinate system.

Cargo.description: Base cargo object used in cargo-related events.

mass.description: Mass of the cargo in kilograms.

position.description: A `Vec3` representing the cargo's current position in the DCS World coordinate system.

displayName.description: The human-readable name of the cargo shown in mission interfaces and logs.

DynamicCargo.description: Dynamic cargo object that can be moved during mission.

id.description: Unique identifier of the dynamic cargo.

type.description: The type classification of cargo, determining its visual model and behavior properties.

mass.description: Mass of the dynamic cargo in kilograms.

Box3.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing a 3D bounding box in the DCS World coordinate system, specified by minimum and maximum corner points.

min.description: A `Vec3` representing the minimum corner point (lowest x, y, z values) of the bounding box in the DCS World coordinate system.

max.description: A `Vec3` representing the maximum corner point (highest x, y, z values) of the bounding box in the DCS World coordinate system.

SceneryObjectDesc.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing a scenery object's properties and physical characteristics in the DCS World.

life.description: A numeric value representing the initial health or integrity level of the scenery object.

box.description: A box (two Vec3 points) representing the three-dimensional collision boundaries of the scenery object in the DCS World coordinate system.

category.description: An `Object.Category` enumerator representing the category of the scenery object.

categoryEx.description: A `Weapon.Category` enumerator representing the subcategory of the scenery object.

Callsigns_JTAC.description: Enumerator for Joint Terminal Attack Controller (JTAC) callsigns, used to identify JTAC units in communications and mission planning.

Unit.Category.description: Enumerator for unit categories, used to classify entities by their basic type and operational domain.

Unit.RefuelingSystem.description: Enumerator for aerial refueling system types, used to specify compatible air-to-air refueling equipment configurations.

Unit.SensorType.description: Enumerator for sensor system categories, used to classify detection and targeting equipment on units.

Unit.OpticType.description: Enumerator for optical sensor technologies, used to specify visual detection capabilities of units.

Unit.RadarType.description: Enumerator for radar system classifications, used to differentiate between air search and surface search capabilities.

UnitAttributes.description: A table of capability and characteristic flags that define the features and abilities of a unit. Fields correspond to attributes from the Attributes enum.

UnitAmmoDesc.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing the specifications and capabilities of a weapon or ammunition type available to a unit.

rangeMaxAltMax.description: A numeric value representing the maximum weapon range in meters when fired at maximum altitude.

rangeMin.description: A numeric value representing the minimum effective range of the weapon in meters.

displayName.description: A string containing the human-readable name of the weapon as displayed in the DCS World interface.

rangeMaxAltMin.description: A numeric value representing the maximum weapon range in meters when fired at minimum altitude.

altMax.description: A numeric value representing the maximum altitude in meters at which the weapon can be effectively used.

RCS.description: A `Box3` representing the radar cross-section characteristics of the weapon.

box.description: A box (two Vec3 points) representing the physical dimensions of the weapon in the DCS World coordinate system.

altMin.description: A numeric value representing the minimum altitude in meters at which the weapon can be effectively used.

life.description: A numeric value representing the weapon's health or structural integrity.

fuseDist.description: A numeric value representing the distance in meters at which the weapon's fuse activates.

typeName.description: A string containing the internal type identifier for the weapon.

Nmax.description: A numeric value representing the maximum G-load the weapon can withstand.

UnitAmmoItem.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing a specific weapon or ammunition type and its quantity in a unit's inventory.

count.description: A numeric value indicating the quantity of this ammunition type available to the unit.

desc.description: A table representing the specifications and capabilities of this ammunition type.

UnitSensorHemisphereDistance.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing detection ranges based on aspect angle within a hemisphere.

tailOn.description: A numeric value representing the maximum detection distance in meters when facing the rear of the target.

headOn.description: A numeric value representing the maximum detection distance in meters when facing the front of the target.

UnitSensorDetectionDistanceAir.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing a sensor's air target detection capabilities in different hemispheres.

upperHemisphere.description: A table representing detection distances for targets positioned above the sensor's horizontal plane.

lowerHemisphere.description: A table representing detection distances for targets positioned below the sensor's horizontal plane.

UnitSensor.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing a sensor system's capabilities and technical specifications.

type.description: An `Unit.SensorType` enumerator specifying the general category of the sensor system.

typeName.description: A string containing the specific model name or designation of the sensor.

detectionDistanceAir.description: A table containing the sensor's detection ranges against aerial targets from different aspects.

detectionDistanceIdle.description: A numeric value representing the maximum detection distance in meters against idle (non-emitting) targets.

detectionDistanceMaximal.description: A numeric value representing the maximum absolute detection distance in meters under optimal conditions.

detectionDistanceAfterburner.description: A numeric value representing the maximum detection distance in meters against targets using afterburner.

UnitDesc.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing the basic properties and capabilities common to all unit types in the DCS World.

typeName.description: A string containing the internal identifier for the unit type used by the DCS World engine.

displayName.description: A string containing the human-readable name of the unit as shown in the DCS World interface.

category.description: An `Unit.Category` enumerator specifying the basic classification of the unit.

massEmpty.description: A numeric value representing the unit's empty weight in kilograms.

speedMax.description: A numeric value representing the unit's maximum speed in meters per second.

life.description: A numeric value representing the unit's total health or structural integrity.

RCS.description: A numeric value representing the unit's radar cross-section signature.

box.description: A box (two Vec3 points) representing the unit's physical dimensions in the DCS World coordinate system.

attributes.description: A table defining special characteristics and capabilities of the unit.

Kmax.description: A numeric coefficient related to the unit's performance characteristics.

Kab.description: A numeric coefficient related to afterburner performance for aircraft.

UnitDescAircraft.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing common properties specific to both airplane and helicopter units in the DCS World. Includes all fields from UnitDesc plus the following aircraft-specific fields.

fuelMassMax.description: A numeric value representing the maximum internal fuel capacity in kilograms.

range.description: A numeric value representing the maximum operational range in meters at standard cruise settings.

Hmax.description: A numeric value representing the service ceiling (maximum operational altitude) in meters.

VyMax.description: A numeric value representing the maximum rate of climb in meters per second.

NyMin.description: A numeric value representing the minimum safe negative G-load limit.

NyMax.description: A numeric value representing the maximum safe positive G-load limit.

tankerType.description: An `Unit.RefuelingSystem` enumerator specifying the aerial refueling system installed, if any.

UnitDescAirplane.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing performance characteristics specific to fixed-wing aircraft in the DCS World. Includes all fields from UnitDesc and UnitDescAircraft plus the following airplane-specific fields.

speedMax0.description: A numeric value representing the maximum true airspeed in meters per second at sea level.

speedMax10K.description: A numeric value representing the maximum true airspeed in meters per second at 10,000 meters altitude.

UnitDescHelicopter.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing performance characteristics specific to rotary-wing aircraft in the DCS World. Includes all fields from UnitDesc and UnitDescAircraft plus the following helicopter-specific fields.

HmaxStat.description: A numeric value representing the maximum hover ceiling in meters (altitude at which the helicopter can maintain a stable hover).

UnitDescVehicle.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing performance characteristics specific to ground vehicles in the DCS World. Includes all fields from UnitDesc plus the following vehicle-specific fields.

maxSlopeAngle.description: A numeric value representing the maximum terrain slope angle in radians that the vehicle can traverse.

riverCrossing.description: A boolean value indicating whether the vehicle has amphibious capabilities to cross water obstacles.

speedMaxOffRoad.description: A numeric value representing the maximum speed in meters per second when traveling on unpaved terrain.

UnitDescShip.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing performance characteristics specific to naval vessels in the DCS World. Includes all fields from UnitDesc plus any ship-specific fields.

TriggerZoneCircular.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing a circular area used for spatial trigger conditions in the DCS World.

position.description: A `Position3` representing the center point and orientation of the trigger zone in the DCS World coordinate system.

radius.description: A numeric value defining the radius of the circular trigger zone in meters.

trigger.smokeColor.description: Enumerator for smoke colors, used to specify colored smoke effects in trigger actions.

trigger.flareColor.description: Enumerator for flare colors, used to specify colored illumination flares in trigger actions.

MarkupShapeId.description: Enumerator for markup geometric shape types, used with trigger.action.markupToAll to create map annotations.

MarkupLineType.description: Enumerator for line style patterns, used to customize map markup line appearances in trigger actions.

BigSmokeType.description: Enumerator for smoke and fire effect variants, used to specify visual effect intensity and characteristics in trigger actions.

RadioModulation.description: Enumerator for radio transmission modulation types, used to specify signal modulation in trigger communication actions.

Attributes.description: Enumerator for unit capability and classification attributes, used to identify unit properties and targeting criteria in the DCS World.

EventData.description: Event data structure that contains information about an event. The id field identifies which type of event is being handled.

id.description: The event ID that identifies the type of event.

time.description: Timestamp when the event occurred in mission time.

initiator.description: The initiating object (can be a Unit, StaticObject, or other object type depending on event).

target.description: The target object involved in the event (present in hit, kill, shooting events).

weapon.description: The weapon used during the event (present in shot, hit, kill events).

WeaponName.description: Name of the weapon (present in weapon_add events).

place.description: The place object (used in landing, takeoff, birth, base_captured events).

subplace.description: The specific location within the place (used in birth events).

MarkID.description: ID of the mark in mark-related events.

Zone.description: The zone object in trigger zone events.

Cargo.description: The cargo object in cargo-related events.

IniPlayerName.description: Name of the player that initiated the event.

TgtPlayerName.description: Name of the player that was targeted.

EventHandlerTable.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing an event handler object that can be registered with world.addEventHandler.

onEvent.description: Function that handles simulator events when they occur. Called with (self, event) parameters where event is of type EventData.

EventDataBase.description: Base structure for all event data. Contains common fields present in every event.

id.description: The event ID that identifies the type of event.

time.description: Timestamp when the event occurred in mission time.

initiator.description: The initiating object (can be a Unit, StaticObject, or other object type depending on event).

EventDataShot.description: Event data structure for S_EVENT_SHOT events. Occurs whenever any unit fires a weapon.

id.description: The event ID that identifies the type of event.

time.description: Timestamp when the event occurred in mission time.

initiator.description: The initiating object (can be a Unit, StaticObject, or other object type depending on event).

EventDataHit.description: Event data structure for S_EVENT_HIT events. Occurs whenever an object is hit by a weapon.

id.description: The event ID that identifies the type of event.

time.description: Timestamp when the event occurred in mission time.

initiator.description: The initiating object (can be a Unit, StaticObject, or other object type depending on event).

weapon.description: The weapon that hit the target. May be nil in multiplayer due to desync issues.

EventDataTakeoff.description: Event data structure for S_EVENT_TAKEOFF events. Occurs when an aircraft takes off.

id.description: The event ID that identifies the type of event.

time.description: Timestamp when the event occurred in mission time.

initiator.description: The initiating object (can be a Unit, StaticObject, or other object type depending on event).

place.description: The airbase or ship from which the takeoff occurred.

EventDataLand.description: Event data structure for S_EVENT_LAND events. Occurs when an aircraft lands.

id.description: The event ID that identifies the type of event.

time.description: Timestamp when the event occurred in mission time.

initiator.description: The initiating object (can be a Unit, StaticObject, or other object type depending on event).

place.description: The airbase or ship where the landing occurred.

EventDataBaseCaptured.description: Event data structure for S_EVENT_BASE_CAPTURED events. Occurs when a base is captured.

id.description: The event ID that identifies the type of event.

time.description: Timestamp when the event occurred in mission time.

initiator.description: The initiating object (can be a Unit, StaticObject, or other object type depending on event).

EventDataBirth.description: Event data structure for S_EVENT_BIRTH events. Occurs when an object is spawned.

id.description: The event ID that identifies the type of event.

time.description: Timestamp when the event occurred in mission time.

initiator.description: The initiating object (can be a Unit, StaticObject, or other object type depending on event).

place.description: The place where the unit was spawned, if applicable.

subplace.description: The specific location type within the place where the unit was spawned.

EventDataKill.description: Event data structure for S_EVENT_KILL events. Occurs when a unit kills another unit.

id.description: The event ID that identifies the type of event.

time.description: Timestamp when the event occurred in mission time.

initiator.description: The initiating object (can be a Unit, StaticObject, or other object type depending on event).

weapon.description: The weapon that caused the kill, if applicable.

id.description: The event ID that identifies the type of event.

time.description: Timestamp when the event occurred in mission time.

initiator.description: The initiating object (can be a Unit, StaticObject, or other object type depending on event).

MarkID.description: ID of the mark that was added, changed, or removed.

EventDataShootingStart.description: Event data structure for S_EVENT_SHOOTING_START events. Occurs when continuous shooting begins.

id.description: The event ID that identifies the type of event.

time.description: Timestamp when the event occurred in mission time.

initiator.description: The initiating object (can be a Unit, StaticObject, or other object type depending on event).

target.description: The target being shot at, if applicable.

EventDataWeaponAdd.description: Event data structure for S_EVENT_WEAPON_ADD events. Occurs when a weapon is added to a unit.

id.description: The event ID that identifies the type of event.

time.description: Timestamp when the event occurred in mission time.

initiator.description: The initiating object (can be a Unit, StaticObject, or other object type depending on event).

WeaponName.description: Name of the weapon that was added.

EventDataGeneric.description: Comprehensive event data structure containing all possible fields from any event type.

id.description: The event ID that identifies the type of event.

time.description: Timestamp when the event occurred in mission time.

initiator.description: The initiating object (can be a Unit, StaticObject, or other object type depending on event).

IniObjectCategory.description: (UNIT/STATIC/SCENERY) The initiator object category (Object.Category.UNIT or Object.Category.STATIC).

IniDCSUnit.description: (UNIT/STATIC) The initiating DCS Unit or StaticObject.

IniUnit.description: (UNIT) The initiating MOOSE Unit wrapper of the initiator Unit object.

IniUnitName.description: (UNIT) The initiating UNIT name (same as IniDCSUnitName).

IniGroupName.description: (UNIT) The initiating GROUP name (same as IniDCSGroupName).

IniTypeName.description: (UNIT) The type name of the initiator.

IniPlayerName.description: (UNIT) The name of the initiating player in case the Unit is a client or player slot.

IniPlayerUCID.description: (UNIT) The UCID of the initiating player in case the Unit is a client or player slot.

target.description: (UNIT/STATIC) The target object (Unit/StaticObject/other depending on event type).

TgtObjectCategory.description: (UNIT/STATIC) The target object category (Object.Category.UNIT or Object.Category.STATIC).

TgtDCSUnit.description: (UNIT/STATIC) The target DCS Unit or StaticObject.

TgtUnitName.description: (UNIT) The target UNIT name (same as TgtDCSUnitName).

TgtGroupName.description: (UNIT) The target GROUP name (same as TgtDCSGroupName).

TgtTypeName.description: (UNIT) The type name of the target.

TgtPlayerName.description: (UNIT) The name of the target player in case the Unit is a client or player slot.

TgtPlayerUCID.description: (UNIT) The UCID of the target player in case the Unit is a client or player slot.

weapon.description: The weapon used during the event (present in shot, hit, kill events).

WeaponPlayerName.description: Player name associated with the weapon, if applicable.

WeaponUNIT.description: Sometimes, the weapon is a player unit.

place.description: The place object (used in landing, takeoff, birth, base_captured events).

subplace.description: The specific location within the place (used in birth events).

MarkID.description: ID of the mark in mark-related events.

MarkGroupID.description: Group ID associated with the mark, if applicable.

Cargo.description: The cargo object in cargo-related events.

IniDynamicCargo.description: The dynamic cargo object in dynamic cargo events.

IniDynamicCargoName.description: The name of the dynamic cargo.

Zone.description: The zone object in zone-related events.

EventTypeMap.description: Maps event IDs to their respective event data types. Used to document which event types correspond to which event IDs.

S_EVENT_PILOT_DEAD.description: Event data for pilot dead events (ID 9).

S_EVENT_BASE_CAPTURED.description: Event data for base captured events (ID 10).

S_EVENT_MISSION_START.description: Event data for mission start events (ID 11).

S_EVENT_MISSION_END.description: Event data for mission end events (ID 12).

S_EVENT_TOOK_CONTROL.description: Event data for took control events (ID 13).

S_EVENT_REFUELING_STOP.description: Event data for refueling stop events (ID 14).

S_EVENT_HUMAN_FAILURE.description: Event data for human failure events (ID 16).

S_EVENT_DETAILED_FAILURE.description: Event data for detailed failure events (ID 17).

S_EVENT_ENGINE_STARTUP.description: Event data for engine startup events (ID 18).

S_EVENT_ENGINE_SHUTDOWN.description: Event data for engine shutdown events (ID 19).

S_EVENT_PLAYER_ENTER_UNIT.description: Event data for player enter unit events (ID 20).

S_EVENT_PLAYER_LEAVE_UNIT.description: Event data for player leave unit events (ID 21).

S_EVENT_PLAYER_COMMENT.description: Event data for player comment events (ID 22).

S_EVENT_SHOOTING_START.description: Event data for shooting start events (ID 23).

S_EVENT_SHOOTING_END.description: Event data for shooting end events (ID 24).

S_EVENT_MARK_ADDED.description: Event data for mark added events (ID 25).

S_EVENT_MARK_CHANGE.description: Event data for mark change events (ID 26).

S_EVENT_MARK_REMOVED.description: Event data for mark removed events (ID 27).

S_EVENT_UNIT_LOST.description: Event data for unit lost events (ID 30).

S_EVENT_LANDING_AFTER_EJECTION.description: Event data for landing after ejection events (ID 31).

S_EVENT_PARATROOPER_LENDING.description: Event data for paratrooper landing events (ID 32).

S_EVENT_DISCARD_CHAIR_AFTER_EJECTION.description: Event data for discard chair after ejection events (ID 33).

S_EVENT_WEAPON_ADD.description: Event data for weapon add events (ID 34).

S_EVENT_TRIGGER_ZONE.description: Event data for trigger zone events (ID 35).

AI.Option.Air.val.REACTION_ON_THREAT.description: Enumerator for threat response behaviors available to AI-controlled aircraft.

AI.Option.Air.val.RADAR_USING.description: Enumerator for radar usage policies available to AI-controlled aircraft.

AI.Option.Air.val.FLARE_USING.description: Enumerator for flare countermeasure usage policies available to AI-controlled aircraft.

AI.Option.Air.val.ECM_USING.description: Enumerator for electronic countermeasure usage policies available to AI-controlled aircraft.

AI.Option.Air.val.MISSILE_ATTACK.description: Enumerator for missile engagement range policies available to AI-controlled aircraft.

AI.Option.Ground.val.ROE.description: Enumerator for Rules of Engagement settings available to AI-controlled ground units.
