AI.Option.Naval.val.ROE.description: Enumerator for Rules of Engagement settings available to AI-controlled naval units.

AIOptionId.description: Union type of all option identifier enumerators used across different AI unit types.

FormationType.description: Enumerator for all formation patterns used across different AI unit types.

RefPoint.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing a reference point used by Joint Terminal Attack Controllers (JTACs) and other mission elements for targeting and navigation.

callsign.description: A string identifier serving as the callsign or designation for the reference point.

type.description: A numeric identifier categorizing the reference point's purpose or classification.

point.description: A `Vec3` representing the precise 3D position of the reference point in the DCS World coordinate system.

ColorRGBA.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing a color with red, green, blue, and alpha components, each normalized between 0.0 and 1.0.

r.description: Red component value between 0.0 (no red) and 1.0 (maximum red intensity).

g.description: Green component value between 0.0 (no green) and 1.0 (maximum green intensity).

b.description: Blue component value between 0.0 (no blue) and 1.0 (maximum blue intensity).

a.description: Alpha (transparency) component value between 0.0 (fully transparent) and 1.0 (fully opaque).

CommandActivateICLS.description: Defines the structure of a command that activates an Instrument Carrier Landing System (ICLS) beacon for aircraft carriers.

CommandActivateICLSParams.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table containing parameters for the ICLS beacon activation.

type.description: Fixed value of 131584 identifying an ICLS beacon type.

channel.description: ICLS channel number (1-20) that aircraft will tune to for landing guidance.

unitId.description: ID of the ship unit that will broadcast the ICLS beacon signal.

name.description: Descriptive name of the ICLS beacon for identification purposes only.

CommandSetInvisible.description: Defines the structure of a command that toggles a group's visibility to enemy AI sensors.

CommandSetInvisibleParams.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table containing parameters for the invisibility toggle command.

value.description: Invisibility state where true makes the group undetectable by enemy AI, false restores normal detection.

CommandActivateLink4.description: Defines the structure of a command that activates a Link 4 data link system for aircraft carrier operations.

CommandActivateLink4Params.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table containing parameters for the Link 4 activation command.

unitId.description: ID of the ship unit that will broadcast the Link 4 signal (must have Link 4 capability).

frequency.description: Operating frequency in Hertz for the data link communications.

name.description: Descriptive name of the Link 4 system for identification purposes only.

CommandEPLRS.description: Defines the structure of a command that toggles the Enhanced Position Location Reporting System (EPLRS) data link capabilities for a unit or group.

CommandEPLRSParams.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table containing parameters for the EPLRS data link toggle command.

value.description: EPLRS state where true activates the data link, false deactivates it.

groupId.description: Track number assigned to the first unit in the group (only relevant for ground vehicle groups).

CommandSetCallsign.description: Defines the structure of a command that changes a group's identification callsign for radio communications.

CommandSetCallsignParams.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table containing parameters for the callsign change command.

callname.description: Callsign name identifier (varies by unit type; 1-19 for JTAC units per Callsigns_JTAC enum).

number.description: Numeric suffix for the callsign (1-9), used to distinguish between units with the same callname.

CommandSetUnlimitedFuel.description: Defines the structure of a command that toggles infinite fuel supply for a unit or group.

CommandSetUnlimitedFuelParams.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table containing parameters for the unlimited fuel toggle command.

value.description: Fuel state where true prevents fuel depletion during operation, false restores normal fuel consumption.

CommandDeactivateBeacon.description: Defines the structure of a command that deactivates any active radio navigation beacon on a unit or group.

CommandDeactivateBeaconParams.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table containing parameters for the beacon deactivation command.

CommandActivateACLS.description: Defines the structure of a command that activates an Automatic Carrier Landing System (ACLS) on an aircraft carrier.

CommandActivateACLSParams.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table containing parameters for the ACLS activation command.

unitId.description: ID of the ship unit that will provide the ACLS functionality (requires carrier with appropriate systems).

name.description: Descriptive name of the ACLS for identification purposes only.

CommandSwitchWaypoint.description: Defines the structure of a command that changes the active route leg for a group, allowing control of navigation between waypoints.

CommandSwitchWaypointParams.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table containing parameters for the waypoint switching command.

fromWaypointIndex.description: Index of the waypoint where the group will begin its new route leg.

goToWaypointIndex.description: Index of the destination waypoint the group will navigate toward.

CommandScript.description: Defines the structure of a command that executes a Lua script within the context of a group, providing access to the group through the '...' self-reference.

CommandScriptParams.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table containing parameters for the script execution command.

command.description: Lua code string to be executed within the group's context.

CommandSetImmortal.description: Defines the structure of a command that toggles a group's invulnerability to all damage.

CommandSetImmortalParams.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table containing parameters for the immortality toggle command.

value.description: Immortality state where true makes the group immune to all damage, false restores normal vulnerability.

CommandLoadingShip.description: Defines the structure of a command that adjusts a ship's cargo loading level, affecting its buoyancy and water line position.

CommandLoadingShipParams.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table containing parameters for the ship cargo loading command.

cargo.description: Cargo load percentage (0-100) determining how much the ship sits in water (lower values raise the waterline).

unitId.description: ID of the ship unit whose cargo load level will be modified.

CommandId.description: Enumerator for command identifiers that can be sent to Controller entities, used to specify the type of command being issued.

CommandSetFrequency.description: Defines the structure of a command that changes the radio broadcasting frequency for an AI group.

CommandSetFrequencyParams.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table containing parameters for the frequency change command.

frequency.description: Radio frequency in Hertz (note: mission editor displays MHz, multiply by 1,000,000 to convert).

power.description: Radio transmit power in watts, determining broadcast range.

CommandStopTransmission.description: Defines the structure of a command that terminates any active radio message transmission from a unit or group.

CommandStopTransmissionParams.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table containing parameters for the transmission termination command.

CommandStart.description: Defines the structure of a command that activates an initially inactive group, triggering AI units to follow their designated route.

CommandStartParams.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table containing parameters for the group activation command.

CommandSwitchAction.description: Defines the structure of a command that changes the active task action within a mission group's task queue.

CommandSwitchActionParams.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table containing parameters for the action switching command.

actionIndex.description: Index of the target action in the group's task queue to make active.

CommandDeactivateACLS.description: Defines the structure of a command that deactivates any active Automatic Carrier Landing System (ACLS) on a unit or group.

CommandDeactivateACLSParams.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table containing parameters for the ACLS deactivation command.

CommandDeactivateLink4.description: Defines the structure of a command that deactivates any active Link 4 data link system on a unit or group.

CommandDeactivateLink4Params.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table containing parameters for the Link 4 deactivation command.

CommandStopRoute.description: Defines the structure of a command that halts or resumes a ground group's movement along its route.

CommandStopRouteParams.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table containing parameters for the route control command.

value.description: Movement state where true halts the group in place, false allows it to resume following its route.

CommandSetFrequencyForUnit.description: Defines the structure of a command that changes the radio broadcasting frequency for a specific unit within an AI group.

CommandSetFrequencyForUnitParams.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table containing parameters for the unit-specific frequency change command.

frequency.description: Radio frequency in Hertz (note: mission editor displays MHz, multiply by 1,000,000 to convert).

power.description: Radio transmit power in watts, determining broadcast range.

unitId.description: ID of the specific unit within the group whose radio frequency will be modified.

CommandActivateBeacon.description: Defines the structure of a command that activates a radio navigation beacon on a unit or group.

CommandActivateBeaconParams.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table containing parameters for the beacon activation command.

type.description: Beacon type identifier determining its functional characteristics.

system.description: Navigation system that will process the beacon signal.

frequency.description: Broadcast frequency in Hertz for the navigation beacon.

callsign.description: Morse code identifier transmitted by the beacon for identification.

name.description: Descriptive name for the beacon shown in the mission editor interface.

CommandSmokeOnOff.description: Defines the structure of a command that toggles aircraft smoke pod emission.

CommandSmokeOnOffParams.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table containing parameters for the smoke toggle command.

value.description: Smoke state where true activates smoke emission, false deactivates it.

CommandDeactivateICLS.description: Defines the structure of a command that deactivates any active Instrument Carrier Landing System (ICLS) beacon on a unit or group.

CommandDeactivateICLSParams.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table containing parameters for the ICLS beacon deactivation command.

CommandTransmitMessage.description: Defines the structure of a command that broadcasts an audio message over a unit or group's active radio frequency.

CommandTransmitMessageParams.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table containing parameters for the radio message transmission command.

file.description: Path to the sound file that will be played as the radio transmission.

duration.description: Display time in seconds for the message subtitles (ignored when loop is true).

subtitle.description: Text displayed in the radio message queue representing the transmission content.

loop.description: Transmission mode where true causes the message to repeat continuously until stopped.

TaskEnRouteEWR.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing an en-route task that assigns the group to act as an EWR radar for friendly forces.

TaskEnRouteEWRParams.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table containing parameters for the EWR task (no parameters required).

TaskEnRouteFAC.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing an en-route task that assigns the controlled group to act as a Forward Air Controller or JTAC. Any detected targets will be assigned as targets to the player via the JTAC radio menu.

TaskEnRouteFACParams.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table containing parameters for the FAC task.

frequency.description: Radio frequency to use for the JTAC communications.

modulation.description: Radio modulation type for JTAC communications.

priority.description: The priority of the tasking, where lower numbers indicate higher importance (default: 0).

TaskEnRouteEngageGroup.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing an en-route task that assigns the controlled group to search for and engage a specific group. The target must be detected for AI to engage it.

TaskEnRouteEngageGroupParams.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table containing parameters for the engageGroup task.

groupId.description: Unique identifier for the target group.

weaponType.description: Defines the preferred weapon type to engage the enemy.

expend.description: Defines how many munitions the AI will expend per attack run (QUARTER, TWO, ONE, FOUR, HALF, ALL).

attackQty.description: Number of times the group will attack if the target is still alive and AI still have ammo.

direction.description: Defines the direction from which the flight will engage from (in radians).

attackQtyLimit.description: Determines if the attack quantity limit is enabled.

priority.description: The priority of the tasking, where lower numbers indicate higher importance (default: 0).

TaskEnRouteTanker.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing an en-route task that assigns the aircraft to act as an airborne tanker for friendly forces. The aircraft must be a certified tanker aircraft.

TaskEnRouteTankerParams.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table containing parameters for the tanker task (no parameters required).

TaskEnRouteEngageUnit.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing an en-route task that assigns the controlled group to search for and engage a specific unit. The target must be detected for AI to engage it.

TaskEnRouteEngageUnitParams.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table containing parameters for the engageUnit task.

unitId.description: Unique identifier of the target unit.

weaponType.description: Defines the preferred weapon type to engage the enemy.

expend.description: Defines how many munitions the AI will expend per attack run (QUARTER, TWO, ONE, FOUR, HALF, ALL).

attackQty.description: Number of times the group will attack if the target is still alive and AI still have ammo.

direction.description: Defines the direction from which the flight will engage from (in radians).

attackQtyLimit.description: Determines if the attack quantity limit is enabled.

groupAttack.description: If true, each aircraft in the group will attack the unit.

priority.description: The priority of the tasking, where lower numbers indicate higher importance (default: 0).

TaskEnRouteFACEngageGroup.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing an en-route task that assigns the controlled group to act as a Forward Air Controller or JTAC and engage the specified group as a JTAC target once detected.

TaskEnRouteFACEngageGroupParams.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table containing parameters for the FAC_EngageGroup task.

groupId.description: ID of the group that is to be assigned by JTAC.

weaponType.description: Weapon flag type that defines the preferred weapon of choice.

designation.description: Type of designation to be used (NO, WP, IR_POINTER, LASER, AUTO).

datalink.description: Determines whether the JTAC will send the 9-line via SADL, enabled by default.

frequency.description: Radio frequency to use for the JTAC communications.

modulation.description: Radio modulation type for JTAC communications.

priority.description: The priority of the tasking, where lower numbers indicate higher importance (default: 0).

TaskEnRouteAWACS.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing an en-route task that assigns the aircraft to act as an AWACS for friendly forces.

TaskEnRouteAWACSParams.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table containing parameters for the AWACS task (no parameters required).

TaskEnRouteEngageTargets.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing an en-route task that assigns the controlled group to engage targets matching specific parameters.

TaskEnRouteEngageTargetsParams.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table containing parameters for the engageTargets task.

targetTypes.description: Table of target categories to engage.

priority.description: Priority of the task, where lower numbers indicate higher importance.

maxDistEnabled.description: Whether to use the maxDist parameter.

maxDist.description: Maximum distance to search for targets in meters.

maxAltEnabled.description: Whether to use the maxAlt parameter.

maxAlt.description: Maximum altitude for targets in meters.

minAltEnabled.description: Whether to use the minAlt parameter.

minAlt.description: Minimum altitude for targets in meters.

TaskEnRouteEngageTargetsInZone.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing an en-route task that assigns the controlled group to engage targets with specific attributes within a defined zone.

TaskEnRouteEngageTargetsInZoneParams.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table containing parameters for the engageTargetsInZone task.

point.description: A `Vec2` point defining the center of the area the group will engage targets within in the DCS World coordinate system.

zoneRadius.description: Radius in meters defining the size of the area the group will engage targets within.

targetTypes.description: Table of attribute names that define valid targets.

priority.description: The priority of the tasking, where lower numbers indicate higher importance (default: 0).

TaskEnRouteId.description: Enumerator for en-route task identifiers that can be assigned to Controller entities but are not globally accessible.

TaskCarpetBombing.description: Assigns a point on the ground for which the AI will attack. Similar to the bombing task, but with more control over target area. Can be combined with follow big formation task for all participating aircraft to simultaneously bomb a target.

carpetLength.description: Distance in meters the pattern should cover

x.description: X coordinate of the target (alternative to point)

y.description: Y coordinate of the target (alternative to point)

weaponType.description: Weapon flag type to use for the attack

expend.description: Quantity of weapons to expend (QUARTER, TWO, ONE, FOUR, HALF, ALL)

attackQty.description: Number of times the group will attack the target

attackQtyLimit.description: Whether to use the attackQty parameter

groupAttack.description: If true then each aircraft in the group will attack the point

altitude.description: Altitude in meters for the attack

altitudeEnabled.description: Whether to use the altitude parameter

TaskBombing.description: Assigns a point on the ground for which the AI will attack. Best used for discriminant carpet bombing of a target or having a GBU hit a specific point on the map.

x.description: X coordinate of the target (alternative to point)

y.description: Y coordinate of the target (alternative to point)

weaponType.description: Weapon flag type to use for the attack

expend.description: Quantity of weapons to expend (QUARTER, TWO, ONE, FOUR, HALF, ALL)

attackQty.description: Number of times the group will attack the target

attackQtyLimit.description: Whether to use the attackQty parameter

groupAttack.description: If true then each aircraft in the group will attack the point

altitude.description: Altitude in meters for the attack

altitudeEnabled.description: Whether to use the altitude parameter

attackType.description: Attack profile to use (e.g. 'Dive' for dive bombing)

TaskHold.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing a hold task that commands ground forces to cease movement and maintain their current position.

params.description: A table containing parameters for the hold task.

TaskHoldParams.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table for hold parameters, which is currently empty as the task requires no additional configuration.

TaskAttackUnit.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing an attack task that directs a group to engage a specific unit.

params.description: A table containing parameters that configure the attack behavior.

TaskAttackUnitParams.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table detailing configuration options for a unit attack mission.

unitId.description: Unique ID of the unit to attack.

weaponType.description: Weapon flag type to use for the attack.

expend.description: Quantity of weapons to expend during the attack (QUARTER, TWO, ONE, FOUR, HALF, ALL).

direction.description: Attack direction in radians, defining the approach vector.

attackQtyLimit.description: Determines whether to use the attackQty parameter as a limit.

attackQty.description: Number of attack passes the group will perform on the target.

groupAttack.description: Determines whether each aircraft in the group will attack individually (true) or as a coordinated unit (false).

TaskRecoveryTanker.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing a naval recovery tanker task that directs an aircraft to orbit above a vessel group, providing refueling services.

params.description: A table containing parameters that configure the recovery tanker behavior.

TaskRecoveryTankerParams.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table detailing configuration options for a naval recovery tanker mission.

groupId.description: The group ID of the naval group to follow and provide tanker services to.

speed.description: Speed of the tanker in meters per second while performing its orbit pattern.

altitude.description: Altitude in meters at which the tanker will orbit above the naval group.

lastWptIndexFlag.description: Determines whether the tanker task should terminate when the naval group reaches a specific waypoint.

lastWptIndex.description: Waypoint index of the naval group that, when reached, will cause the recovery tanker to end its task.

TaskLand.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing a landing task that directs helicopters to touch down at specific coordinates.

params.description: A table containing parameters that configure the landing behavior.

TaskLandParams.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table detailing configuration options for a helicopter landing operation.

point.description: A `Vec2` representing the landing coordinates in the DCS World coordinate system where the helicopter will attempt to touch down.

durationFlag.description: Determines whether the helicopter will remain on the ground for a specific duration before taking off again.

duration.description: Time in seconds that the helicopter will remain landed before automatically taking off if durationFlag is true.

TaskFireAtPoint.description: Assigns a point on the ground for which the AI will shoot at. Most commonly used with artillery to shell a target.

point.description: Vec2 coordinate to define where the AI will aim

x.description: X coordinate of the target (alternative to point)

y.description: Y coordinate of the target (alternative to point)

radius.description: Optional radius in meters that defines the area AI will attempt to hit

expendQty.description: Specifies number of shots to be fired

expendQtyEnabled.description: Whether or not expendQty will be used

weaponType.description: Weapon flag type to use for the attack

altitude.description: If present the task will be focused on shooting at the specified altitude for the point

alt_type.description: Determines if the altitude is defined by AGL (1) or MSL (0)

counterbattaryRadius.description: The radius in meters from the group leader that the group will move in random directions after completing the fireAtPoint task

TaskStrafing.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing a strafing task that directs AI to perform gun or rocket attacks on a ground point.

params.description: A table containing parameters that configure the strafing attack behavior.

TaskStrafingParams.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table detailing configuration options for a strafing attack mission.

point.description: A `Vec2` representing the target coordinates in the DCS World coordinate system.

x.description: X coordinate of the target (alternative to using the point field).

y.description: Y coordinate of the target (alternative to using the point field).

weaponType.description: Weapon flag type to use for the attack.

expend.description: Quantity of weapons to expend during the attack (QUARTER, TWO, ONE, FOUR, HALF, ALL).

attackQty.description: Number of attack passes the group will perform on the target.

attackQtyLimit.description: Determines whether to use the attackQty parameter as a limit.

direction.description: Attack direction in radians, defining the approach vector.

directionEnabled.description: Determines whether to use the specified direction for attack.

groupAttack.description: Determines whether each aircraft in the group will attack individually (true) or as a coordinated unit (false).

length.description: Total length of the strafing target area in meters.

TaskRefueling.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing an air refueling task directing aircraft to seek and connect with the nearest available tanker.

params.description: A table containing parameters for the refueling task.

TaskRefuelingParams.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table for refueling parameters, which is currently empty as the task requires no additional configuration.

TaskAttackMapObject.description: Assigns the nearest world object to the point for AI to attack.

point.description: Vec2 coordinate of the target point

x.description: X coordinate of the target (alternative to point)

y.description: Y coordinate of the target (alternative to point)

weaponType.description: Weapon flag type to use for the attack

expend.description: Quantity of weapons to expend (QUARTER, TWO, ONE, FOUR, HALF, ALL)

attackQty.description: Number of times the group will attack if the target

attackQtyLimit.description: If true the attackQty value will be followed

groupAttack.description: If true then each aircraft in the group will attack the target

TaskEscort.description: Controlled aircraft will follow the assigned group along their route in formation and will engage threats within a defined distance from the followed group.

groupId.description: Unique ID of the group to escort

pos.description: Vec3 point defining the relative position the controlled flight will form up on

formation.description: Formation pattern to use when escorting the group. Use AircraftFormationType for fixed-wing aircraft or HelicopterFormationType for helicopters.

lastWptIndexFlag.description: If true the AI will follow the group until it reaches a specified waypoint (default: true)

lastWptIndex.description: Identifies the waypoint at which the following group will stop its task (default: -1)

engagementDistMax.description: Maximum distance of targets from the followed aircraft that the AI will actively engage

targetTypes.description: Array of attribute types which the AI will engage

TaskFollowBigFormation.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing an advanced formation-following task for coordinated bombing missions with multiple aircraft.

params.description: A table containing parameters that configure the formation-following behavior.

TaskFollowBigFormationParams.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table detailing configuration options for large-scale formation flying between aircraft groups.

groupId.description: Unique ID of the lead aircraft group to follow.

pos.description: A `Vec3` representing the relative position the controlled flight will maintain within the formation in the DCS World coordinate system.

formation.description: Formation pattern to use when following the group, must match aircraft type (fixed-wing or helicopter).

lastWptIndexFlag.description: Determines whether the AI will terminate the follow task when the lead group reaches a specified waypoint.

lastWptIndex.description: Waypoint index of the lead group that, when reached, will cause the following aircraft to terminate the task.

TaskBombingRunway.description: Assigns the AI a task to bomb an airbases runway. By default the AI will line up along the length of the runway and drop its payload.

runwayId.description: Index of the airbase for which is to be bombed

weaponType.description: Weapon flag type to use for the attack

expend.description: Quantity of weapons to expend (QUARTER, TWO, ONE, FOUR, HALF, ALL)

attackQty.description: Number of times the group will attack the target

attackQtyLimit.description: Whether to use the attackQty parameter

direction.description: If provided the AI will attack from this azimuth and ignore bombing along the length of the runway

groupAttack.description: If true then each aircraft in the group will attack the runway

TaskGroundEscort.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing a ground escort task that directs helicopters to provide aerial protection for ground units.

params.description: A table containing parameters that configure the ground escort behavior.

TaskGroundEscortParams.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table detailing configuration options for helicopter escort operations above ground forces.

groupId.description: Unique ID of the ground group to escort and protect.

engagementDistMax.description: Maximum distance in meters defining the size/length of the orbit pattern before the helicopter returns to the escorted group.

lastWptIndexFlag.description: Determines whether the helicopter will follow the ground group until it reaches a specified waypoint.

lastWptIndex.description: Waypoint index at which the escorting helicopter will terminate its escort task.

targetTypes.description: A numerically indexed table of `Attributes` defining which enemy unit types the escorting helicopter will engage.

lastWptIndexFlagChangedManually.description: Indicates whether the lastWptIndexFlag was manually configured rather than using system defaults.

TaskAttackGroup.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing an attack task that directs a group to engage another group.

params.description: A table containing parameters that configure the attack behavior.

TaskAttackGroupParams.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table detailing configuration options for a group attack mission.

groupId.description: Unique ID of the group to attack.

weaponType.description: Weapon flag type to use for the attack.

expend.description: Quantity of weapons to expend during the attack (QUARTER, TWO, ONE, FOUR, HALF, ALL).

directionEnabled.description: Determines whether to use the specified direction for attack.

direction.description: Attack direction in radians, defining the approach vector.

altitudeEnabled.description: Determines whether to use the specified altitude for attack.

attackQtyLimit.description: Determines whether to use the attackQty parameter as a limit.

attackQty.description: Number of attack passes the group will perform on the target.

TaskFACAttackGroup.description: Assigns the controlled group to act as a Forward Air Controller or JTAC in attacking the specified group. This task adds the group to the JTAC radio menu and interacts with a player to destroy the target.

groupId.description: ID of the group that is to be assigned by JTAC

weaponType.description: Weapon flag type that defines the preferred weapon of choice

designation.description: Type of designation to be used (NO, WP, IR_POINTER, LASER, AUTO)

datalink.description: Determines whether or not the JTAC will send the 9-line via SADL, enabled by default

frequency.description: Radio frequency to use for the JTAC

TaskOrbit.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing an orbit task that directs aircraft to fly various pattern types at specified locations.

params.description: A table containing parameters that configure the orbit behavior and pattern.

TaskOrbitParams.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table detailing configuration options for aircraft orbit patterns and behavior.

pattern.description: Type of orbit pattern the AI will execute (RACE_TRACK, CIRCLE, Anchored).

point.description: A `Vec2` representing the primary orbit point in the DCS World coordinate system.

point2.description: A `Vec2` representing the secondary point for a Race-Track orbit pattern in the DCS World coordinate system.

speed.description: Speed in meters per second the AI will maintain during the orbit pattern.

altitude.description: Altitude in meters the AI will maintain during the orbit.

hotLegDir.description: Heading in radians that the aircraft will fly for the return leg of the anchored orbit pattern.

legLength.description: Distance in meters that the aircraft will fly before turning in an anchored orbit pattern.

width.description: Distance in meters that represents the diameter of the anchored orbit pattern.

clockWise.description: Determines whether the anchored orbit will fly clockwise (true) or anti-clockwise (false).

TaskId.description: Enumerator for task identifiers used to assign specific behaviors to Controller entities in the DCS World.

TaskFollow.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing a follow task that directs aircraft to join formation with another group or orbit above ground units.

params.description: A table containing parameters that configure the follow behavior.

TaskFollowParams.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table detailing configuration options for formation flying between aircraft groups.

groupId.description: Unique ID of the group to follow or orbit above if it's a ground unit.

pos.description: A `Vec3` representing the relative position the controlled flight will maintain within the formation in the DCS World coordinate system.

formation.description: Formation pattern to use when following the group, must match aircraft type (fixed-wing or helicopter).

lastWptIndexFlag.description: Determines whether the AI will terminate the follow task when the lead group reaches a specified waypoint.

lastWptIndex.description: Waypoint index of the lead group that, when reached, will cause the following aircraft to terminate the task.

WrappedAction.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing a wrapper that allows a command or action to be used as a task.

params.description: A table containing the action to be wrapped as a task.

WrappedActionParams.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table containing the action that will be executed as a task.

action.description: The command or action object to be executed as a task.

ControlledTask.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing a task with start and stop conditions that determine when to execute and terminate the task.

params.description: A table containing parameters that configure the task execution conditions.

ControlledTaskParams.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table detailing configuration options for controlled task execution.

condition.description: A table specifying the conditions that must be met for the task to start.

stopCondition.description: A table specifying the conditions that will trigger task termination.

ControlledTaskCondition.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table detailing conditions that must be met for a task to start.

time.description: Time in seconds since mission start when the task should begin.

userFlag.description: Flag identifier to check for task activation.

userFlagValue.description: Required value of the user flag to activate the task.

probability.description: Probability (0-100) that the task will execute when conditions are met.

ControlledTaskStopCondition.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table detailing conditions that will trigger task termination.

time.description: Time in seconds since mission start when the task should terminate.

userFlag.description: Flag identifier to check for task termination.

userFlagValue.description: Required value of the user flag to terminate the task.

duration.description: Duration in seconds that the task will run before terminating.

lastWaypoint.description: Waypoint number that, when reached, will terminate the task.

Mission.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing a route-based mission consisting of waypoints assigned to a group.

params.description: A table containing parameters that define the mission configuration.

MissionParams.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table detailing mission execution parameters and route information.

airborne.description: Indicates whether the aircraft group is already airborne when the mission is assigned.

route.description: A table containing the route waypoints to be followed during the mission.

MissionRoute.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table containing an ordered sequence of waypoints that form a route.

points.description: A numerically indexed table of waypoint objects that define the mission route.

MissionWaypoint.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing a single navigation point within a mission route.

airdromeId.description: Unique identifier of the airdrome for takeoff or landing waypoints.

timeReFuAr.description: Time in minutes allocated for refueling and rearming at an airdrome.

helipadId.description: Unique identifier of the helipad for helicopter operations.

linkUnit.description: Unique identifier of the linked unit (same as helipadId but required for certain operations).

action.description: Turn method the aircraft will use when approaching this waypoint.

x.description: X coordinate of the waypoint in the DCS World coordinate system.

y.description: Y coordinate of the waypoint in the DCS World coordinate system.

alt.description: Altitude of the waypoint in meters.

alt_type.description: Altitude measurement reference ('RADIO' for AGL, 'BARO' for MSL).

speed.description: Speed in meters per second the aircraft will maintain at this waypoint.

speed_locked.description: Determines whether the speed value is fixed and cannot be optimized by AI.

ETA.description: Estimated time of arrival at the waypoint in seconds from mission start.

ETA_locked.description: Determines whether the ETA value is fixed and AI must adjust speed to meet it.

name.description: Descriptive name of the waypoint for identification purposes.

task.description: Task to be performed when the aircraft reaches this waypoint.

ComboTask.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing a composite task that combines multiple tasks to be executed sequentially or in parallel.

params.description: A table containing parameters that define the tasks to be combined.

ComboTaskParams.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table detailing the collection of tasks to be executed as part of a combination.

tasks.description: A numerically indexed table of task objects to be executed.

LiquidType.description: Enumerator for liquid fuel types, used to specify particular fuels within a `Warehouse` inventory.

env.Mode.description: Enumerator for mission execution lifecycle states, used to determine the current operational phase of a mission in the DCS World environment.

world.BirthPlace.description: Enumerator for aircraft and helicopter spawn locations, used in birth events.

world.VolumeType.description: Enumerator for 3D volume types used in spatial queries within the DCS World.

world.event.description: Enumerator for event types that occur during mission execution in the DCS World.

Group.Category.description: Enumerator for group categories, used to classify different types of unit collections in the DCS World environment.

ControllerDetectedTarget.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table representing a target detected by a controller, including its object reference and detection details.

object.description: Reference to the detected target object.

visible.description: Whether the target is currently visible via line of sight.

type.description: Whether the target's specific type is known to the detector.

distance.description: Whether the distance to the target is known to the detector.

ControllerDetectedTargetArray.description: Represents a numerically indexed Lua table (sequence) where each element is a table containing information about a detected target.

ControllerTask.description: Represents a Lua table structure defining either a main task or an enroute task that can be assigned to a controller to direct AI behavior.

ControllerCommand.description: Represents a Lua table structure defining an immediate command that can be issued to a controller to affect AI behavior without modifying tasks.

Controller.Detection.description: Enumerator for detection method types, used to specify or filter how controllers detect targets in the DCS World environment.

Spot.Category.description: Defines the types of targeting beams available in the DCS World environment.

AirbaseParking.description: Information about an airbase parking spot.

land.SurfaceType.description: Defines terrain surface types in the DCS World environment.

coalition.side.description: Enumerator for coalition sides, used to identify the different factions in the DCS World environment.

coalition.service.description: Enumerator for coalition service types, used to categorize radio communication services available to each faction.

DCSAvailableSlotInfo.description: Defines the structure of a Lua table containing information about a player-controllable slot in a mission, including its unit ID, type, role, and other identifying data.

CoalitionObject.description: Represents all Objects those may belong to a coalition: units, airbases, static objects, weapon. Non-final class.

getCoalition.description: Returns an enumerator that defines the coalition that an object currently belongs to.

getCountry.description: Returns an enumerator that defines the country that an object currently belongs to.

Object.Category.description: Defines the fundamental categories of objects in the DCS World environment.

ObjectArray.description: Represents a numerically indexed table of `Object` instances.

ObjectCategoryArray.description: Represents a numerically indexed table of `Object.Category` enum values.

ObjectAttributes.description: Defines the structure of a table containing attribute flags for an object. Each field is a boolean indicating whether the object has that specific attribute.

StaticObject.Category.description: Defines the categories of static objects in the DCS World environment.
